data.name: Muazah
data.gender_notes: Muazah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'aza' which means 'to please, be pleasing'. In Islamic context, it refers to someone who is desirable and pleasing to Allah. The name Muazah carries the meaning “Desirable, Pleasing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muazah usually hope their child will grow to embody desirable, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Muazah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Desirable, Pleasing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muazah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
